name: Falling Away
overview: The biblical concept of 'Falling Away' warns believers about the real danger of turning away from God through unbelief and offense against one another, as Jesus foretold many would betray and hate one another in the last days. Hebrews cautions believers to guard their hearts against departing from the living God, emphasizing the severity of abandoning faith after having experienced the enlightenment and the Holy Spirit. Romans illustrates this by describing branches broken off to allow others to be grafted in, highlighting the consequences of unfaithfulness. James encourages endurance under temptation and calls the community to restore those who have erred from the truth, underscoring both the challenge and hope present in the journey of faith.
